text_block_list.text: —And then, some time passed.
Today, at Duramente's request, I was asked to instruct her juniors.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
There are quite a lot of spectators here.
...Though I am not particularly fond of noisy crowds.
choice_data_list: After all, Duramente is a Double Crown Uma Musume now
Duramente is a Double Crown Uma Musume now, you know

text_block_list.text:
After that, Duramente advanced
to the Classic Triple Crown. And then—

Brilliantly conquering both the Satsuki Sho and the Nippon Derby,
she has now surpassed even her master.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your pupil, is it...
Very well, let us begin.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... very much...
That speed was incredible,
I couldn't keep up at all...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: That's true. At that pace, it won't be much of a match. Maybe next time...

text_block_list.name: Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm totally fine!
One more rep—no, make it about five more, please!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...... If nothing else, your stamina is bottomless.
Fine then, let's keep running until you're satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Bravo, simply marvelous!

From up high, a shadowy figure
applauded Admire Groove.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
For someone who joined the school later on,
you're doing quite an impressive job coaching.
Admire Groove-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Rulership-san...

This Umamusume is Rulership.
She's a pupil of Air Groove and an upperclassman
at the academy, but...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Here comes that noisy pest again.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
N-N-N-Nagging, you say?!
Why, you little~~~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, dammit, what gives...
She's holding all the cards over me,
every single time...!!
She's a tactician who loves board games, yet for some reason, Admire Groove always wraps her right around her finger.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Alv-senpai...
She didn't mean any harm, you know.

text_block_list.name: Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Because there isn't any!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I understand that, but...
Oh? Earlier, you were...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
On closer inspection, you aren't a student at the academy, are you?
An outsider?

text_block_list.name: Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm not enrolled in a school, but
Duramente-senpai teaches me elsewhere!

text_block_list.name: Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Because Duramente-senpai acts as a special coach in all sorts of places!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes. School is certainly important, but—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, I would like to spread your and the teacher's
teachings even more widely."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Thorough, attentive one-on-one sessions are great, but—
I want to reach as many Umamusume as possible."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, there is more than one path to victory.
A polar-opposite approach naturally exists as well.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
From now on, we must expand the board.
Until this field is completely filled—
by my legion.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san, you have
your own way of thinking, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to do as you like.
Keeping the connection going is a good thing, no matter the form.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Don't ignore me!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*, I'm just going home...
What's her problem, acting like a big sister...

Rulership headed home.
Once she recharges her batteries,
she'll probably be back just like always.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...So it's not just one, huh?
I see... that makes sense."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
How the school should be run, how to teach running,
and even myself.
I will broaden my horizons by embracing new ways of thinking.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I think that's a good thing.
Yeah, I think that's a good thing.

text_block_list.text:
The attentive, personal coaching of a small school is certainly
important, of course. However—

At a certain point, the "scope of teachings" can expand.
Not just to a select few, but spreading out to
the entire Umamusume world...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
That role... Duramente will fulfill it.
If that's the case—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san, as a Double Crown Umamusume,
you know the most important mission entrusted to you, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: A mission? That would be—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: That is something you yourself—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: To live a long, healthy life.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Wishing for a future that will never be reached.
Wishing for a future I will never see to the end.
And yet now... here I am by your side.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "The power within oneself to overcome any hardship. The power given by the one who lit the path in darkness and served as a guide—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "Taking the long way around was probably necessary... because to make my wish come true, I needed the strength of both combined."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
That is why... from here on, with this strength...
I will always be by your side.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep showing you the model example with my own body.
Understood?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
To live on... in good health...
—Yes, I understand. I promise.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
From the "wandering" of a "lone star"
to the "restoration" of a "triple star"...
...Toward a "window"—that no one has ever seen...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...No more hesitating now.

There is a song that flows down the river.
A song that began as a lullaby—
Before long, it turned into a raging song, spreading across the fertile plains in an instant.

The singer of a lullaby desires――
only one thing.

"For my child to continue living in good health.
—That is all I ask."
